top_band: light warm brown horizontal top surface from row 2 to row 5 (with a darker back rim at row 2 and lighter surface rows 3-5), plus row 6 front edge
evidence: Reading down a middle column: rows 2-5 form a 4-row lighter brown horizontal top surface (with small objects resting on it at rows 1-3). Row 6 is a distinct medium-brown front edge line of the top slab, and row 7 is a dark brown eave shadow directly beneath it. Rows 7-28 show the vertical front face with 20 inset drawers (shaded with top highlight, bottom/right shadow, and yellow pulls), supported by legs at rows 29-31.

style.evidence: The cabinet uses a 5-step brown wood ramp plus yellow and cream ramps for the top props and drawer pulls. Outlines are dark brown material tones rather than black. The front face is broken up by 20 shaded drawers with 3D beveling and drop shadows, avoiding large flat fills, though the top surface and repetitive drawer grid have slightly less organic grain than the Beodeul references.
